items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: And it was given to me by Cal Tjader.

ctx.x: Ralph was, well you know Ralph, he’s always a killjoy with other people. He can’t stand people. And they were all getting on their hats and ready to go, and he goes like this you know. And the whistles and they’re starting up this stuff. And about quarter to twelve they’re starting this noise in the joint. So Ralph comes out about ten minutes to twelve or five minutes to twelve, he goes into a New Year’s Eve song, whatever, “Auld Lang Syne.” And people are — “what?” They’ve got another five or ten minutes, and he…
Ralph was doing this. I held up a big sign like this. Fuck communism it says. Red White and Blue. And it was given to me by Cal Tjader. You remember Cal Tjader?
